reviews.title: Easily to build in and clean minimalistic aesthetic
reviews.comment:
beautifully crafted Mini-ITX case that combines premium materials with a compact form factor. Its anodized aluminum body and solid walnut front panel offer a sleek, minimalist aesthetic that fits seamlessly into any setup. Despite its small size, the Terra accommodates GPUs up to 322mm in length, thanks to its adjustable internal layout and included PCIe 4.0 riser cable .
Building in the Terra is straightforward, with tool-less panels and a sliding motherboard tray that make installation and maintenance a breeze . However, cooling options are limited, supporting only a single 120mm fan, which may pose challenges for high-TDP components . Overall, the Terra Jade is an excellent choice for those seeking a stylish, compact case without compromising on build quality.
reviews.author: Gabe

reviews.title: Excellent case. The hype is real, and justified!
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/B1Qr830oQML.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/819z1CFhIqL._SY256.jpg Building in this was VERY easy. It was my 3rd build, and first ITX build. I built the whole thing at a leisurely pace while I took photos and posted them for my buddies to follow along through discord.
I was worried about building in an ITX case because they're notoriously annoying. Nope. Only one single ITX gripe. *INSTALL ALL THE MOTHERBOARD SCREWS BEFORE THE COOLER AND PLUG IN YOUR CPU FAN TO THE HEADER BEFORE SEATING THE COOLER.*. I had to dismount the cooler twice, but otherwise it was really fun and a nice experience.
Build quality is top notch, and instructions made the build a breeze.
Unboxing everything from brand new to gaming took me about 3 hours.
I actually like this little case so much, I might get one for myself. My girlfriend wanted the green one, and it does look really nice. She loves it! It feels very well designed, and the premium features and finish help justify the hefty price tag.

reviews.title: Very well thought out case. Compact and stays cool.
reviews.comment: Very compact case and a very attractive design. Despite being very compact, the PC stays cool with a Ryzen 7 9700X and a Radeon RX 9070. The only negative I can say is the CPU fan against the side grill can be noisy with how the air whistles through depending on the alignment and cooler you use.
